articles.summary: Veteran Banker and Licensed Fiduciary to Serve on the Audit Committee and the Compensation, Nomination and Governance Committee MindWalk Holdings Corp. ("MindWalk") (NASDAQ: HYFT), a Bio-Native AI company, today announced the appointment of Kim Remizowski to its Board of Directors as an independent director, effective September 29, 2026. Mr. Remizowski will serve on the Audit Committee and the Compensation, Nomination and Governance Committee. The Board has determined that he qualifies as an independent director under Nasdaq listing rules and as an audit committee financial expert under applicable SEC rules. With this appointment, the Board comprises four directors, three of whom are independent. Mr. Remizowski most recently served as Director, Private Equity at Vistra, a global corporate services group operating in more than 50 jurisdictions, where he oversaw governance for a portfolio of investment funds and holding structures. articles.summary: As data platforms and industry analysts converge on the "ontology layer" as the missing piece of agentic AI, MindWalk outlines why life sciences needs a biological context layer of its own, and why ReefIQ™, powered by HYFT® Technology, is that layer MindWalk Holdings Corp. ("MindWalk") (NASDAQ: HYFT), a Bio-Native AI company, today outlined why the ontology layer now being built across enterprise AI does not reach biological function, and why life sciences requires a biological context layer of its own.
